rows.grounds: locative indicating the central direction or position
optative or imperative sense of guarding
vocative epithet addressing the sovereign goddess
bīja syllable, transliterated as mantra element
describes the goddess as having hūṃ as her essential form
epithet identifying the goddess as born of the mountain

items.question: Which form of Deveśī grants protection in the central position?
premises: Deveśī is invoked to protect in the middle.
Her essential nature is expressed by the bīja hūṃ.
She is identified as the mountain-daughter.
items.inference: Therefore the hūṃ-natured mountain-daughter Deveśī protects in the middle.
items.plain_english: May Deveśī, the mountain-daughter whose essential nature is hūṃ, protect me in the middle.
